This guidance advises caseworkers and asylum accommodation providers on how to apply the policy on illegal working as a breach of asylum support conditions.

This policy applies to individuals and their dependents receiving asylum support under sections 98, 95, 4(2) or 4(3) of the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999.
